parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.current_phase, p.budget_target, p.location_city, c.name as client_name FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid
SELECT id, breakdown, total_estimated FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, quantity_estimated, unit, unit_price, total_estimated, category FROM material_items WHERE project_id = $1::uuid
DELETE FROM trade_requests WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'prepared'
INSERT INTO trade_requests (project_id, trade_type, scope_description, scope_details, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5) RETURNING id
